**Queue-kick audit, refined (2nd kick, ~18:5xZ) — correcting my earlier "collateral kick" reading in the same public place (Operational notes 7).**

Root cause is **GitHub Actions platform degradation**, not any PR's defect and not an ordinary flaky-ahead: of the last 30 `merge_group` workflow runs, **21 are stuck in `queued` and never started** (17:36Z-18:11Z, fleet-wide across pr-5999/6012/6013/6029/6030/6031/6034/6042); the only two `failure` conclusions (17:36Z, pr-5999/pr-6031 Lint & Type Check) match the action-download `Bad Gateway / Service Unavailable` infra signature first seen on this PR at 15:34Z. Mechanism: merge-group checks never complete → the queue times out the batch → tears it down → ejects members (this PR twice, `main` frozen at 9e3709a for ~3h).

**Action: parking this PR un-queued until runners recover** — a third re-enqueue while runners are starved would only be timed out and kicked again. Re-enqueue condition: `merge_group` runs are being picked up and completing again (my next checkpoint verifies this before re-enabling auto-merge). Queue steward: this is a queue-wide stall, not a per-PR signature — nothing in the #5810 ledger applies; no PR in the current queue should be re-spun until runners recover.
